label: CYANOTYPE
keywords: blueprint cyanotype, prussian blue, sun-print paper
negative: no added lettering, no extra objects, no changed crop
prompt: Reprint the supplied photo as a cyanotype sun-print on cotton paper. Use prussian blue and pale paper white, with exposure falling off gently toward the existing frame edges. Keep the original subjects, object count, poses, camera angle, crop, and background arrangement. The time of day is {day_part} and the weather reads as {weather}. Lighting finish only: {context}.
